blog.post3Title: Istrian Wine: A Journey Through Vineyards
blog.post3Excerpt: Malvazija, Teran, and Muskat — Istrian wines are making waves worldwide. Explore the cellars and vineyards that make this region special.
blog.post4Excerpt: From medieval castles to poolside ceremonies under the stars, Istria offers the dreamiest wedding backdrop in the Mediterranean.
blog.post5Excerpt: Keep the whole family entertained with water parks, medieval villages, and outdoor adventures. Istria is a paradise for families of all ages.
blog.articleP1: The rolling hills of Istria, dotted with centuries-old olive groves and vineyards, have long been a sanctuary for those who seek an authentic Mediterranean experience. Nestled in the heart of this peninsula, the medieval village of Svetvincenat offers a gateway to a world where time seems to slow, where every meal tells a story, and where the landscape itself becomes a companion to your journey.
blog.articleP2: Istria has been called many things: the new Tuscany, Croatia's hidden gem, a food lover's paradise. Yet none of these labels quite capture its essence. It is a place of contrasts, where the azure waters of the Adriatic meet ancient hilltop towns shrouded in morning mist, where Roman ruins stand beside contemporary art galleries, and where a simple plate of hand-rolled pasta becomes an unforgettable experience.
blog.articleP3: For visitors staying at Villa Ballena or Villa Beluga, the experience begins the moment you arrive. The warm stone, the scent of Mediterranean herbs drifting through open windows, the sound of cicadas on a summer evening — these are the details that transform a holiday into a memory. The villas themselves are designed to be a seamless extension of the Istrian landscape, with materials and aesthetics that honor the region's traditions while embracing contemporary luxury.
blog.articleP4: Beyond the villas, the region unfolds like a series of beautifully curated chapters. Drive fifteen minutes in any direction and you might find yourself at a family winery pouring biodynamic Malvazija, at a coastal town where the day's catch is grilled over open flames, or at a forest clearing where trained dogs sniff out the prized white truffle. Each experience is distinct yet connected by the common thread of Istrian hospitality — warm, genuine, and unhurried.
blog.articleP5: Whether you come for the gastronomy, the beaches, the culture, or simply the peace of a private pool under the Croatian sun, Istria rewards curiosity. It is a destination that reveals itself slowly, layer by layer, inviting you to return again and again. And with Villa Ballena and Villa Beluga as your home base, every adventure begins and ends in comfort.
blog.articleCtaBody: Make Istria your home for a week. Explore the region from the comfort of a luxury villa with a heated pool, private sauna, and everything you need.

about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Two villas, one philosophy
about.story: Villa Ballena and Villa Beluga were born from a deep love for Istria — its rolling hills, truffle forests, and sun-drenched coastline. Built in 2021 in the heart of Svetvinčenat, just steps from a medieval castle, these two sister villas represent our vision of what a perfect Mediterranean retreat should be: private, beautifully designed, and deeply connected to the land.
about.philosophy: We believe luxury should feel effortless. No check-in desks, no rigid schedules, no compromise. Just thoughtfully designed spaces, warm hospitality, and the freedom to create your own rhythm. Whether you're here for a quiet wellness escape or a lively family celebration, we want you to feel at home — in the most extraordinary way.
about.value1Desc: Your own fenced grounds, private pool, and secluded terrace. No shared lobbies, no neighbors peering over. Just your family and the Istrian sky.
about.value2Desc: Every detail is intentional. From the underfloor heating to the biological pool water, our villas blend contemporary aesthetics with functional luxury.
about.value3Desc: We are rooted in Istria. We know the truffle hunters, the winemakers, the fishermen. Every experience we recommend is one we have lived ourselves.
about.value4Desc: No rigid schedules or impersonal service. Just attentive, warm support when you need it and complete freedom when you do not.
about.ctaBody: Whether you seek a quiet wellness retreat or a lively family celebration, Villa Ballena and Villa Beluga await you in the heart of Istria.
